1000-DALYTRAN-GET-NEXT: Read each transaction sequentially from DALYTRAN file and increment WS-TRANSACTION-COUNT for every record.
1500-A-LOOKUP-XREF: Lookup card number in XREF file; if not found, set reject reason 100 with description 'INVALID CARD NUMBER FOUND'.
1500-B-LOOKUP-ACCT: Lookup account by account ID from XREF record; if not found, set reject reason 101 with description 'ACCOUNT RECORD NOT FOUND'.

1500-B-LOOKUP-ACCT: Compute temporary balance (CYC-CREDIT - CYC-DEBIT + TRAN-AMT); if account credit limit is less than temporary balance, set reject reason 102 with description 'OVERLIMIT TRANSACTION'.

1500-B-LOOKUP-ACCT: If account expiration date is less than transaction origination date (first 10 characters), set reject reason 103 with description 'TRANSACTION RECEIVED AFTER ACCT EXPIRATION', overwriting any prior overlimit reject reason 102.

2000-POST-TRANSACTION: For valid transactions, populate transaction record with input fields, generate DB2 timestamp for TRAN-PROC-TS, update category balance and account balance, and write posted transaction.

2500-WRITE-REJECT-REC: For rejected transactions, increment WS-REJECT-COUNT and write 430-byte reject record containing the 350-byte input record plus 4-digit reason and 76-character reason description.
2700-UPDATE-TCATBAL: Lookup transaction category balance by account ID, type code, and category code; if not found create new record with amount, else add transaction amount to existing balance.
2800-UPDATE-ACCOUNT-REC: Add transaction amount to ACCT-CURR-BAL; if amount >= 0 add to ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT, else add to ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT.
PROCEDURE DIVISION: Display processed and rejected transaction counts; if reject count > 0, set return code to 4, otherwise return code remains 0.
